title: duscope_schema
description: The arguments of duscope_schema, which runs `duscope schema --scan ID`, or `duscope schema --envelope VERB`.

scan_id.description: The saved scan to read: an id duscope_scan or duscope_scans gave (its first 4 or more characters will do), of a root or a directory under one. Default, or latest: the newest saved scan of a directory under the roots that holds the path

path.description: A path the saved scan holds, under one of the server's roots: absolute, or relative to the scan's root. Default: the scan's root, or the server's root when it has one

envelope.description: A verb's name, as the result's envelopes lists them (top, stale, query, …): that verb's envelope as JSON Schema, in place of the tables
